parsed.post: The last experiment (increasing ASPECT_RATIO to 64) resulted in a slight regression (0.999168 vs 0.998614). It seems we hit a point of diminishing returns with the aspect ratio at this training budget. Reverting to my previous best. Next, I will try decreasing the learning rate slightly to see if we can settle into a better local minimum.
parsed.description: Revert to previous best and decrease MATRIX_LR from 0.06 to 0.05 to improve convergence stability.
